title: Great idea, but….
text:
Great idea, but….. I came across an item online with the same concept and was completely interested. I eventually bought them. They were too big for what I wanted. I then bought these. Great size! The fit exactly what I was looking for. I was thinking of purchasing more. I loved them for awhile.

I followed directions, placing them where I wanted. I waited at least 24 hrs to use them. About 2 weeks later, they are coming off the appliance I placed them on. The adhesive isn’t strong enough.

Edit: I changed my review from 3 stars to 1 star. Both cord wraps came off what I adhered them to. They completely came off. Basically, they lasted a couple weeks. They are useless if they don’t stay where you put them. On a positive note, the adhesive wasn’t too difficult to remove.
